objective: Select a distinct evidence-acquisition or commitment mechanism after the frozen matched workspace pilot; preserve its protocol and all failures.

sources.title: ARISE: A Repository-level Graph Representation and Toolset for Agentic Fault Localization and Program Repair
sources.observation: Adds statement-level intra-procedural AST definition/use edges and queryable slices to repository navigation. Evaluates Python SWE-bench Lite with Qwen, not our Java or mixed-language GLM campaigns. Distinguishes graph evidence from merely exposing another tool schema.
sources.transfer_inference: If native scoring identifies within-function evidence loss, test a bounded source-only variable-dependency query against an equal-budget source-window control. Return source references, not causal proof; require normal receipt-bound reads before native selection.
limitations: AST approximation is not execution provenance or complete alias/control-flow analysis
Python scope does not cover C++ or documentation requirements
Repository code, licensing, dependency closure and index cost have not been audited here
No ARE replication or improvement follows from the paper

sources.title: A²Agent: Action-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Repository-Level Code Localization Agents
sources.observation: Separates discovery from final commitment and trains a policy using per-turn and terminal rewards based on gold locations. The method requires model training; its rewards must not become inference-time access to benchmark labels.
sources.transfer_inference: After all campaign prediction seals, diagnose undelivered versus delivered-but-unselected evidence using isolated exposed evaluator inputs. This can select the next mechanism without pretending a prompt or memory tool reproduces reinforcement learning.
limitations: Hosted GLM weight-training access is not established
No gold-derived reward, candidate score or per-turn feedback may enter live evaluation
A post-score diagnostic is not confirmation or evidence of causal improvement

public_example_exposure.posture: The paper's retrieved worked example reveals locations. Record this public exposure before selecting any future confirmation cohort; do not silently treat an overlapping case as newly blinded.

sources.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
sources.observation: The interface provides compact actions, informative feedback, guardrails, and a bounded source viewer displaying absolute line numbers. These are interface design mechanisms, not evidence that any particular workspace or GLM policy improves ContextBench.
sources.transfer_inference: Our sealed case09 quotations appear in the source file but outside their requested absolute line ranges. Prospectively test more explicit source coordinates or host-bound citation handles and field-specific recovery feedback, without automatically relocating quotations or weakening provenance validation.
limitations: Software repair and context selection have different objectives
Paper-level results cannot be imported as ARE results
No source viewer change is applied to the running campaign
Only interface-method sections were reviewed; qualitative patch examples were not inspected

sources.title: Writing effective tools for agents — with agents
sections_reviewed: Choosing the right tools for agents
Optimizing tool responses for token efficiency
sources.observation: The engineering guidance recommends high-signal responses and specific, actionable input-validation feedback instead of opaque errors. It also advises evaluating tool interfaces rather than assuming conventional API wrappers are suitable for agents.
sources.transfer_inference: Our workspace returns candidate-workspace.record without naming the failed field or its actual and permitted lengths. A separately frozen interface variant could return bounded field-level diagnostics and measure successful use, native quality, and total cost. Tool-use success alone is not the advancement objective.
limitations: Vendor engineering guidance is not controlled ARE replication
Suggestions must be evaluated with our pinned model and native metrics
No error repair, extra call or validator relaxation occurs in the frozen r1 pilot

sources.title: Query2doc: Query Expansion with Large Language Models
sources.observation: Generates pseudo-documents to expand retrieval queries, with explicit query/expansion balancing for sparse retrieval. The reported experiments use passage retrieval, few-shot training examples and retrievers different from our archived source ranker.
sources.transfer_inference: Test a bounded zero-shot GLM-generated source-query expansion with the existing source ranker. Emit speculative search terms, not purported source text, file paths or evidence. Freeze a cheap exposed source-acquisition screen before labels are used, then require a new full native matched campaign if it qualifies.
limitations: This is an adaptation hypothesis, not an exact Query2doc replication
No benchmark-label examples enter the generator prompt
Generated terms may hallucinate relevance or displace stronger original leads
The native ranker is not the paper's BM25 implementation; blindly repeating query terms is not justified
A source-lead screen cannot establish native quality or superiority

selection_boundary: First finish and inspect the current 24 sealed matched arms and pinned native scores. Diagnose acquisition, commitment and cost separately before selecting one distinct next hypothesis. No running-policy modification, provider dispatch or fresh-label opening is authorized by this research note.

terminal_workspace_evidence.decision_evidence: Mean workspace span coverage loss is .60837 unacquired versus .09218 acquired-but-unselected. The source-acquisition gap dominates; tool-interface repair alone is not selected as the next quality mechanism. Retain all failures and unopened confirmation.

prior_failures: Generic graph/import navigation and lexical region pooling already failed their exposed gates. Do not rename those policies or infer relevance from connectivity alone.
open_questions: Does the matched workspace intervention improve native quality beyond its extra calls and tokens?
Are residual failures predominantly acquisition, selection, within-function coverage, or unsupported semantic judgments?
Can a precise source-query primitive preserve normal native delivery/provenance and complete mixed-language denominators?
Can its full indexing, parsing and inference cost beat the matched control and DSH on untouched confirmation?

Would explicit coordinates, host-bound citation handles or field-level feedback reduce rejected workspace calls without increasing false semantic confidence or merely making a weak mechanism easier to use?
